title: Grassy Terrain

sections.heading: Where it appears
lines: Natural battles in Meadow, Plains, Savanna, and Sunflower Plains.

sections.heading: Description
lines: Grassy Terrain is one of the Field Effects present in Rejuvenation. It is classified as an Elemental field.

sections.heading: Transitions From Other Fields
lines: No other Field Effect can be in place for the field to be created. If another Field Effect is present when the Grassy Terrain is generated, the original Field remains active, and the Grassy Terrain has fewer effects than normal. These will be highlighted by an underline.

Grassy Terrain cannot be overlayed over Frozen Dimensional Field or Underwater Field. If the field changes to Frozen Dimensional Field, the overlay will last until it is destroyed by a move. If the field changes to Underwater Field, the overlay will be destroyed. Grassy Terrain overlay disappears if a different overlay is set while it's still active.
This field is generated by:

The ability Grassy Surge on switch-in and the move Grassy Terrain, for 5 turns normally and 8 turns if the Pokémon holds an Amplifield Rock or when overlayed over Forest Field or Bewitched Woods Field.
The ability Seed Sower when activated, for 5 turns normally and 8 turns if the Pokémon holds an Amplifield Rock or when overlayed over Forest Field or Bewitched Woods Field.
In Flower Garden Field, grows the field 1 stage instead.
The Z-Move Bloom Doom for 3 turns.
Bloom Doom cannot overlay Grassy Terrain over Forest Field.
In Flower Garden Field, grows the field 1 stage instead.
Corrosive Field will transform into this field if the moves Purify or Seed Flare are used.

sections.heading: General Effects
lines: Grass-type moves from grounded Pokémon receive a 1.5x boost. (1.3x when overlayed)
“The Grassy Terrain strengthened the attack!”
Grounded Pokémon restore 1/16 of their max HP each turn unless they are in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move.
“The grassy terrain healed the Pokémon on the field.”
Fire-type moves against grounded Pokémon receive a 1.5x boost.
“The grass below caught flame!”

sections.heading: Abilities Affected
lines: Activated Abilities:
Grass Pelt
Leaf Guard
Overgrow
Buffed Abilities:
Wildfire deals 1/6th max HP damage at the end of each turn instead of 1/16th.
This damage isn't doubled if the target is burned, making it 1/6th regardless of status.
As of V14.0.22, this effect isn't listed in the in-game Field Notes
Cotton Down lowers Speed by 2 stages on activation.
Harvest will always activate at the end of the turn.
Sap Sipper heals 1/16 max HP at the end of the turn.
“[Pokémon] ate some grass to recover!”

sections.heading: Moves Affected
lines: Damage modifiers: Moves which receive an attack buff:
Fairy Wind, Gust, Icy Wind, Ominous Wind, Razor Wind, Silver Wind, Twister, Grass Knot → 1.5x boost.
“The wind picked up strength from the field!”
“The grass strengthened the attack!”
Moves which receive an attack nerf:
Bulldoze, Earthquake, Magnitude, Muddy Water, Surf → 0.5x decrease.
“The grass softened the attack...”
Other effects: Moves which are buffed:
Grassy Glide gains +1 priority.
Inherent effect of the move.
Ingrain heals 1/8 max HP per turn.
Razor Wind only lasts 1 turn.
Absorb, Giga Drain, Mega Drain & Horn Leech heal 75% of damage dealt.
Coil boosts the user's Attack, Defense, and Accuracy by 2 stages.
Cotton Spore lowers the target's speed by 3 stages.
Floral Healing heals 100% of the target's max HP.
Leech Seed recovery is increased by 30%.
This does not increase the damage dealt.
Grass Whistle's accuracy is 80% instead of 55%.
Growth boosts the user's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages.
This does not stack with this move's existing boost in Harsh Sunlight.
Nature's Madness deals 75% HP damage.
Synthesis restores 75% of the target's max HP.
This does not stack with this move's existing boost in Harsh Sunlight.
Worry Seed additionally lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage.

sections.heading: Field-dependent moves & abilities
lines: Mimicry changes the user's type to Grass.
Camouflage changes the user's type to Grass.
Nature Power becomes Energy Ball.
Secret Power can inflict Sleep.
Shelter halves damage from Grass-type moves.
Terrain Pulse becomes Grass-type.

sections.heading: Transitions to Other Fields
lines: Any move in this section inherently gains a 1.3x damage boost on top of any other previously listed modifiers.
This field cannot be transformed to another one if it is overlayed. Any field the Electric Terrain transitions to inherits its timer.
This field will transform into Corrosive Field if either the move Sludge Wave or the Z-Move Acid Downpour is used.
“The grassy terrain was corroded!”
This field will transform into Desert Field when the Desolate Land ability first activates.
“The extremely harsh sunlight dried out the meadow!”
This field will transform into Swamp Field if Surf is used 3 times or Muddy Water is used 2 times.
“The ground became waterlogged...”
“The grassy terrain became marshy!”
Specifically, using Surf increments the counter by +1 and using Muddy Water increments it by +2. The field changes to Swamp Field when the counter reaches 3.

sections.heading: Items
lines: Elemental Seed increases Defense by 1 stage and applies Ingrain to the user.
Big Root's HP restoration increase is doubled to 60%.

sections.heading: Notes
lines: Until V14, this Terrain additionally increased the damage of Snap Trap at the end of the turn to 1/6th.
Grassy Terrain is one of the four Field Effects present in the mainline Pokémon series, although its canonical counterpart applies less effects.
